label: early-middle positions (t=3-6) of the original phase and the <DEL> step, on first-occurrence tokens, preferring o/3/r/z/p
explanation: A positional unit gated by token identity. It fires only at steps t=3..7 (peaking at t=4) during the original phase or on the <DEL> step, and never in the copy phase or at t<2. About a third of the activation mass falls on <DEL> when it arrives at t=3..6 (20% firing rate there). In the original phase it fires almost only on the first occurrence of a token (in_first=1 holds 95% of the mass). It favors o, 3, r, z and p as inputs (rate 9-15% against a 5% base rate), and somewhat favors steps whose previous token is w or k. The largest activations are o/3/r/z on t=3-5 right after a w. Recall drops for longer L because more of each sequence falls past t=7. Position alone (t=3-6, phase<=1) covers 98% of the mass at only 18% precision, and the token set lifts precision to about 40%. The rest of the selectivity depends on the prefix context and was not captured by simple seen() conditions.
